//: Functions run in Sydney, not Washington.
Vercel defaults every new project to iad1, Washington D.C., on the theory
that most external data sources sit on the US east coast. Ours does not:
the database is in ap-southeast-2 and the customers are Australian.
Left at the default, every request would cross the Pacific twice per query
and this application makes several sequential queries per page. A shop that
looks up an item, a price and a source before rendering a row would spend
most of a second on network time alone, and nothing in the code would look
Written here rather than set in the dashboard so it is version controlled,
travels with the repository, and is visible to whoever reads the code next.
A region that lives only in a settings page is a region nobody knows about
Hobby plan allows one region. If this ever moves to Pro, the failover
region should be the nearest one that keeps data in the same jurisdiction,
which today means there is no such region and the honest answer is to stay
single region rather than quietly move Australian personal information to
